EIGV.description: Eigenvalue Analysis (EIGV). The analysis method is chosen by TYPE (EIGEN subspace iteration, LANCZOS, or RITZ vectors); TYPE decides which of the remaining fields apply.

TYPE.description: Eigenvalue analysis method. Case-insensitive. EIGEN = subspace iteration (uses iFREQ, iITER, iDIM, TOL); LANCZOS = Lanczos (uses iFREQ, bMINMAX, FRMIN, FRMAX, bSTRUM); RITZ = Ritz vectors (uses bINCNL, iGNUM, vRITZ).

iITER.description: [TYPE=EIGEN] Number of iterations for subspace iteration.

bMINMAX.description: [TYPE=LANCZOS] Restrict to a frequency range of interest. When true, FRMIN and FRMAX define the search band.

FRMIN.description: [TYPE=LANCZOS] Search-from frequency [cps], used when bMINMAX is true (expected FRMIN < FRMAX).

FRMAX.description: [TYPE=LANCZOS] Search-to frequency [cps], used when bMINMAX is true (expected FRMIN < FRMAX).

iGNUM.description: [TYPE=RITZ] Number of generations for each GL-link force.

vRITZ.description: [TYPE=RITZ] Load cases used to generate Ritz vectors. Required (and must be non-empty) when TYPE=RITZ; at most 50 entries.

KIND.description: Load case source. Case-insensitive. CASE = a defined static load case (name in CASE); GROUND = ground acceleration direction (in GROUND).

CASE.description: [KIND=CASE] Name of the defined static load case.

GROUND.description: [KIND=GROUND] Ground acceleration direction. Case-insensitive. ACCX = X, ACCY = Y, ACCZ = Z.

iNOG.description: Number of generations for this load case.
